items.title: 68154_Gus Johnson oral history interview
items.q: I took Jo Jones' place after he took Shadow's place. And so he left and told them to get me to work with Basie... Shadow Wilson came back. He got -- hired Shadow back into the band.

ctx.x: The first time I got with Basie, I stayed with him until -- and we went in the Strand Theatre. Now, that's -- I took Jo Jones' place after he took Shadow's place. And so he left and told them to get me to work with Basie.
